gloss_text: Someone rang the front door. Movement detected in the entrance area. View the video?
A parcel courier is standing at the gate waiting for confirmation. They have already rung twice.
A person rang the front door. Would you like to answer through the speaker or view the recording?
Your expected visitor Claudia has arrived at the gate. Shall I open the door?
A parcel for number 12 is in the caretaker's lodge. Please collect it by 18:00, afterwards it will be sent back.
The installer for flat 3C is waiting in the entrance area and needs approval in the app.
Transcript: Hi, it's me. Call me back when you can about the restaurant on Saturday. No stress if it's too late.
Transcript: Good day, I am calling about your file. Please call back during business hours.
Voice message from an unknown number: Hello, it is about your warranty. Please call back during the week.
Transcript: Hey, this is Clara. I'm passing the market tomorrow, do you want tomatoes? Just get in touch.
Transcript: I just wanted to say I'm happy for your new office. See you next week.
Voice message from +1 555-0148: Here is the agency, we will discuss it on Monday. No need to hurry.

Who is coming to the lake on Sunday? I'm bringing ice cream 🍦 and Uncle Werner says he's bringing the boules game. Let's meet around 11 at the car park, and please, not late this time! Sophie, can you bring your camera? We need photos for the Christmas card.

Has anyone seen a grey cat with a blue collar at the playground? She is very friendly. Please let the third floor know if you find her. And anyone looking for a plumber: the one from Lindenstraße was with us yesterday and did a great job.
Right guys, the club café opens at 9, we should agree on the kit. I still have the red one, could someone bring the bibs? And Marc, stop claiming you scored the final goal, the video is clear 😂

That Mario Kart tournament was really fun. Does anyone still have the replay? We're doing another round Thursday evening if you feel like it. I found a new trick for the castle track, you have to try it before the season starts.

Forwarded many times: good morning everyone, please send this message on to ten people, it brings luck to your family this week. Whoever doesn't will have bad luck for a month. Have a nice day everyone 🌞

Forwarded: supposedly the canteen will close in January. Nobody has confirmed it and the school management has said nothing. Please don't pass it on unchecked, but if anyone has proof, let us know before we talk to the headteacher tomorrow.

I'm forwarding the picture I received this morning: Good morning, a little smile and a nice day! with a steaming coffee and flowers. Send it to your loved ones, it always brings joy. Thanks to everyone in the neighbourhood.

Owners' meeting on Thursday at 19:30 in the common room. Agenda: facade renovation, garden budget and election of the new caretaker. Please reply by Tuesday evening, there are drinks and biscuits for everyone.

For the street party we are collecting 15 euros per household for the barbecue and sound system. Please transfer it to Julian by the 30th. The party is on 14 July from 16:00 on the square behind the school. Bring your folding chairs!

Reminder: the enrolment meeting is moved to Tuesday at 18:00, room 12. On the agenda: the plan for school trips and the organisation of the Christmas market. Bring ideas for stalls, we will discuss them over coffee.

Smoke reported on the third floor of building B. The fire brigade is on its way. Please leave through the emergency exit in the courtyard, do not use the lift and do not go back in until property management gives the all-clear. Stay calm.

Gas smell reported on Lindenstraße, strong smell. Do not switch on lights, do not use a lighter, open the windows and leave the house now. Rescue services are on their way, please move away from the street and wait for instructions.
Flooding on Mühlenstraße: after the storm the river has burst its banks. Avoid the area, stay on upper floors and follow the instructions of the authorities. The road is closed until further notice.

Hello, a delivery service is at the gate and wants to bring shopping to the second floor. He has already waited five minutes and cannot stay long. Tell me whether he may leave the parcel in the lodge or whether he should drive off.

The fibre technician has arrived for flat 5A. He needs access to the technical room in the basement. Please confirm in the app that you expect him, otherwise he will come back tomorrow morning between 9 and 12. Have a good day.

A visitor, Mr Bernd, is waiting at reception for flat 3C. He says he is expected for dinner tonight. I cannot check this without your confirmation, so I have let him wait in the lobby. Shall I send him up?
Someone rang the entrance door. On the recording a man in a yellow vest holds a parcel and waits in front of the gate. You can reply through the app or leave a message, then he leaves after a minute.
